sideSpacing.rule: Owner ruling T31 (2026-11-01): 16 pt side spacing everywhere, on screens and sheets, phone and tablet, unless the platform guideline (Apple HIG for iOS and iPadOS, Material for Android) sets a value for that exact context. An exception names os, kind, context, value and source.
sideSpacing.checked: No exception is applied. The iPad 20 pt regular-width layout margin is stated only by a third party (Use Your Loaf, 'Changing Root View Layout Margins'); Apple's systemMinimumLayoutMargins page gives no number. Material 3's 24 dp margin for medium windows was found only second-hand (SAP Fiori for Android), and Android tablets use the iPad board. Material's compact margin, 16 dp, already equals the default.

sheet.source: packages/apps/commise/ui/src/sheet/sheetPresentation.ts (SHEET_WIDE_FROM_DP, SHEET_MAX_WIDTH_DP): a bottom sheet on a wide window is capped, still bottom-anchored; only a 'dialog' presentation is centred; SHEET_DIALOG_MAX_WIDTH_DP 448 and SHEET_HANDLE 36 x 5 in the same file

homeIndicatorNote: The OS draws both. iOS is the usual 134 x 5 pill; the Android gesture handle is drawn approximately. Neither is ours to style.
